entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Los Negros Island is the third largest of the Admiralty Islands. It is significant because it contains the main airport of Manus Province on its eastern coastline, at Momote. It is connected to Lorengau, the capital of the province, on Manus Island, via a highway and bridge across the Lonui Passage, which separates Los Negros from the larger Manus Island. It forms part of the Los Negros Rural LLG.
